title: Mixed Event — Unfading Wishing — Episode7 The End of New Year's Day

meta.Episode: Episode7 — The End of New Year's Day
meta.Event Outline: The US trip is coming up fast, and Akito's been practicing at full throttle. He takes a well-earned break on New Year's Day, but while he's out and about, he ends up running into a certain someone...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad to see that you got the plushie you wanted, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Me too!
And thank you so much, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was able to get it after I aimed right where you said I should. I honestly still can't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm glad that I could help.
I was also surprised by just how much you've improved, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really?
Maybe you're rubbing off on me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I might be able to get one of these all on my own next time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It still took you a bunch of tries to get this one, so don't go getting ahead of yourself...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, that's all a part of who Ena is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Do you guys have plans after this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I was wondering if we could try playing some competitive Hanetsuki using the equipment we just bought.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Certainly.
It would be interesting to find out how this differs from regular Hanetsuki.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys.
Then, let's head over to the park!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, it'll be Momoi and me versus Ena and Toya.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's do our best to smash them into the ground, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's pretty big talk.
We aren't about to go easy on you guys either!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, as for the rules... How about we start with the first to five wins?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
We're not just playing around, surely? Let's make things interesting.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well...
We could make it so the losers have to buy the winners some cheesecake!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you're just saying that because you want some.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, having a prize should motivate each side to win!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't mind either way, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Fine, we can play for that. But this means we're really not going easy on you guys.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, we're gonna win and have ourselves some cheesecake.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're not letting them walk away with this, are we, Akito?! Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... It came off my paddle a little funny, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Grr... How was I supposed to get that one?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes! It just barely stayed in!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito's lost his balance!
That means the next one will...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice one, Akito!
That's hook, line and sinker!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, when did Airi get out in front?!
She was way in the back a second ago...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No! I thought we had that point in the bag!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You knew that I was going to lob it into the air like that...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'd both lost our balance, so I figured it was our chance. Thankfully, Momoi was able to capitalize.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You did a great job of acting, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No...!
This is so frustrating for some reason...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, why are you two able to work in perfect sync like this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I definitely wasn't expecting to play Hanetsuki with Momoi and the others today...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been such a strange New Year's Day.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I chose it with Airi's help today.
Call it a parting gift from me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
A parting gift...?
It's not like I'm going away forever or anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, aren't you gonna thank me?
I got this for you because I thought you could use it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not like I asked you to...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks. I'll make good use of it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That's what I like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, good luck.
Go out there and do your thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I didn't realize that she'd gotten this for me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (When we ran into them, I was worried it'd end up ruining my day...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But it actually ended up being a nice way to start off the new year.)
